notes.title: Lia now has AI, allowing you to chat with her using voice or text!
notes.notes:
Update 0.2.4 is Here – And It’s Exciting!

I’m thrilled to announce that you can now talk to Lia directly! 🎉

Lia now has AI, allowing you to chat with her using voice or text. Simply tap the microphone button, say "Hello" or ask her something, then tap it again to hear her response. Prefer texting? Just send a message, and Lia will reply instantly!

Lia can chat with you on various topics—she listens, responds, and engages in conversation like never before. Your virtual girlfriend has never felt this alive!

So, go ahead—start talking to Lia now! 💕
(Currently 0.2.4 update available only on Windows and Linux)
